items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: See, Rene was living there in a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Well, sometimes, like I'd be with a hand there, would be on one and Rene would be on it and his brother would be on the other. See, Rene was living there in a trumpet player. And his brother Joe would be on drums. And he had a saxophone player named Edgar Socia. I don't know if you heard of Edgar Socia. I heard of him. Yeah. Henry Harden, that was a tenor player. Meet up fellas like that, you know. They'd be on one truck, we'd be on another. How did Rene play then?
Oh yeah, he played nice trumpet. He played nice, yeah. And Alvin would be on the truck sometime too.
